divergence: All instruction shapes, control flow, and relocations agree except for a five-way callee-saved register allocation cycle: retail assigns state/strings/kind/context/event to r27/r28/r29/r30/r31, while canonical GC/1.3 assigns strings/kind/context/event/state to r27/r28/r29/r30/r31. This produces 77 DIFF_ARG_MISMATCH instructions per side. Simultaneously mapping retail r27/r28/r29/r30/r31 to canonical r31/r27/r28/r29/r30 makes all 296 address-and-formatted-instruction records byte-identical (cmp exit 0).
